[1] Qiyana has a vulnerable first few levels and limited pressure before unlocking her full basic ability rotation and gaining enough damage to threaten opponents.

[1] Qiyana is extremely vulnerable during levels one and two, so your first goal is usually to preserve your health and collect as much farm as possible. Once you reach level three and unlock all your three basic abilities, you gain much stronger trading and kill pressure.
[1] Qiyana's main early game goal is to reach level three safely with as much health as possible.
[1] At level six, Qiyana's pressure increases dramatically. You can start looking for all-ins in lane, especially when the enemy positions near walls.
[1] If that shockwave hits a wall, river, or brush, it explodes through that area, stunning and damaging every enemy caught inside.
[1] When you use river Q, enemies hit are rooted, then slowed afterwards. This makes it one of the best Qs for starting fights, setting up ganks
[1] If your jungler is nearby, river Q is usually the element you want ready.

[1] When you use brush Q, Qiyana creates a grass trail that makes her invisible and keeps her movement speed while she stays inside. This lets you dodge skill shots, avoid auto attacks, stall for cooldowns
[1] You can also use E on minions, monsters, or champions to target through walls as long as you have vision of the target.
[1] Because Q is range and hits in an area, it becomes your safest way to CS and wave clear.
[1] Use fog of war to camp brushes and punish squishy champions who walk too far forward.
